behaviors.behavior: resolve_diff_mode: CI mode valid, local via --base/--diff-file valid, and the four invalid combinations
list_diff_paths: extracts every header in order, empty diff -> empty list
read_diff_file: decodes valid UTF-8, replaces invalid bytes rather than raising

build_local_diff: includes branch commit + untracked, excludes unrelated base-only commit; never mutates real index/HEAD; disables ext-diff/textconv; unresolvable base returns an error, does not raise

main() local mode: approve -> exit 0 / block -> exit 1, no CI-only boundary called; prints banner+review, never posts; --base end-to-end; empty diff fails closed; truncated diff still prints (regression)
resolve_diff_mode usage errors exit EXIT_USAGE (3), never EXIT_ERROR (2)
a genuine argparse-level failure (not resolve_diff_mode's) also exits EXIT_USAGE, not the 2 argparse itself would otherwise raise
--help still exits 0 through the new SystemExit remap
post_local_result strips control/escape chars from body before printing to a real terminal
empty/"." --diff-file value is not a valid local source (Path("") is truthy)
--base mode's main() call sends the actual merge-base diff content, not just "a" diff
unresolvable --base / unreadable --diff-file exit EXIT_USAGE, never EXIT_ERROR
CI mode regression (pre-existing suite, unmodified behavior)
live end-to-end dogfooding against this branch's real merge-base diff with a real model call
